body: Read latest progress: initial five-case focused invocation failed before builder because fake gh lacked --version. A real fixture correction justifies one focused rerun; the one-targeted-gate instruction avoids redundant/broad checks, it does not prohibit proving corrected tests now execute the production builder/final gate. Do not substitute a broad touched check solely to avoid repeating a newly corrected filter. If shared-test-infra/>10-file policy independently requires test-touched/check-ci-compile, retain those actual requirements. Use normal slots/background/AIDA_CARGO_TIMEOUT, no blind unchanged reruns, fullsuiteCI. Report exact initialfailure and corrected regression results, no pre-fix-sourcefailureclaim from a broken transport fixture. Keep original normal source/approval corpus/history and all signed security boundaries. This clarifies validation only, not source/merge approval.
subject: BUG2406: corrected focused fixture may be rerun meaningfully
